description: This spacious three bedroom semi-detached property offers an excellent opportunity for families or investors alike. The home features well proportioned living accommodation throughout, providing a comfortable and practical layout suitable for modern living. The property benefits from a generous living area, a well sized kitchen, and three bedrooms, offering ample space for a growing family. Externally, the property boasts both a front and rear garden, providing outdoor space ideal. The rear garden offers excellent potential for family use, while the front garden enhances the property's kerb appeal. Conveniently located within easy reach of local amenities, schools, and transport links, this property represents an ideal purchase for families seeking a spacious home or investors looking for a strong rental opportunity.
